posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
My rebuttal? Old school ragtime.

Tom Brier is a genius. He sight reads simple melody lines and improvises around them. That song in the video? His first time seeing those charts or even hearing that song. Be sure to watch the whole thing as he gives it a second shot and does ridiculous things. I’ve been playing piano for over 20 years and his ability just baffles me.

Even if you don’t like ragtime, spend some time looking up Tom Brier videos. He’s freaking amazing.

Additional viewing material: http://youtu.be/wmd1NiVYjEA
And a classic, with some goofiness: http://youtu.be/9DyHFonnu2E

posts.cooked: That’s partially true. If you keep looking at youtube, a lot of these pieces you can see “people have brought” to him before, he’s got much rougher versions of nearly every song on there. While he’s still immensely skilled at playing and improvising, I doubt he’s sight-reading 100% on any of them. Not that it can’t be done, I just think it’s suspicious that he’s brought the same obscure video game sheet music to sight read every time he’s at a public piano with a video camera present. Mario? Sure. 3 different Mario songs? Maybe, ok. Ghosts n’ Goblins? Unlikely. Still, I’d like to see Root Beer Rag out of him, the only ones on youtube are super sloppy.

posts.cooked:
Think what you want, but I happen to know he is 100% sight-reading on them. He’s sight reading plus improvising over them. The Ghosts & Goblins one was the first one I saw from him, actually. Also, in terms of sloppiness, he’s playing on an out of tune piano, sight-reading, in a style in which it’s more important to keep the pace going, rather than worry about if he misses a note here or there, and keep the pace going he does! Look at some of his original works - they’re much cleaner.
